<style>/* Página de vendas Desafio Magra Pro Max (Canva) no Elementor. Tamanhos de texto, cores e espaços ficam nos próprios
   elementos (editáveis no painel). Aqui só o que o Elementor gratuito não faz sozinho. Celular: até 767 px. */
html,body{overflow-x:hidden}
.el-sec,.el-bloco,.el-rodape{font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#2f2f2f;box-sizing:border-box}
.el-sec *,.el-bloco *,.el-rodape *{box-sizing:border-box}
.el-sec p,.el-bloco p,.el-rodape p{margin:0}
/* o tema do WordPress equilibra as linhas dos títulos; o site quebra normal */
.el-sec *,.el-bloco *,.el-rodape *{text-wrap:wrap!important}
.el-sec .elementor-heading-title,.el-bloco .elementor-heading-title{margin:0}
.el-sec{position:relative}
.el-sec>.e-con-inner{position:static}
.el-sec img,.el-bloco img,.el-rodape img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
.elementor-widget-image{line-height:0}

/* destaques dentro do texto */
.y{color:#F85A00;font-weight:700}
.yr{color:#F85A00;font-weight:700}
.ym{color:#F85A00;font-weight:700;background:#fff;padding:0 .22em;border-radius:4px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
.r{color:#F85A00;font-weight:700}

/* larguras máximas (como no site) */
.el-mw640{width:100%!important;max-width:640px!important}.el-mw700{width:100%!important;max-width:700px!important}.el-mw720{width:100%!important;max-width:720px!important}
.el-mw750{width:100%!important;max-width:750px!important}.el-mw760{width:100%!important;max-width:760px!important;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}.el-mw780{width:100%!important;max-width:780px!important}
.el-mw820{width:100%!important;max-width:820px!important}.el-mw860{width:100%!important;max-width:860px!important}.el-mw886{width:100%!important;max-width:886px!important}
.el-mw900{width:100%!important;max-width:900px!important}.el-mw905{width:100%!important;max-width:905px!important}.el-mw940{width:100%!important;max-width:940px!important}
.el-mw980{width:100%!important;max-width:980px!important}.el-mw990{width:100%!important;max-width:990px!important}.el-mw1000{width:100%!important;max-width:1000px!important}
.el-mw1020{width:100%!important;max-width:1020px!important}.el-mw1043{width:100%!important;max-width:1043px!important}

/* seta na divisa entre as seções */
.el-seta{position:absolute!important;left:50%;bottom:-18px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:5;width:auto!important;margin:0!important}
.el-seta-solta{width:auto!important;margin-top:18px!important}
.seta-q{display:flex;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:0}
.seta-verde{background:#1b1b1b}.seta-laranja{background:#F85A00}

/* topo */
.el-olho{width:auto!important;background:#F85A00;border-radius:30px;padding:6px 18px;margin-bottom:20px!important}
.el-chip{width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:30px}
.el-chip .elementor-widget-icon,.el-chip .elementor-widget-text-editor{width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.el-chip .elementor-icon{display:flex;line-height:0}
.el-par-laura{position:relative;width:100%!important;max-width:520px;margin:30px auto 0!important;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.el-par-laura img{width:100%}
.el-tag{position:absolute!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;z-index:2}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-family:Poppins,sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;border-radius:30px;padding:7px 18px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.tag-antes{background:#F85A00;color:#fff}.tag-depois{background:#F85A00;color:#111111}
.el-tag-la{left:14px;bottom:14px}.el-tag-ld{right:14px;bottom:14px}
.el-par{position:relative;width:100%!important;height:560px;margin-top:30px!important}
.el-par-img{height:100%;width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.el-par-img img{height:100%!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.el-flecha{position:absolute!important;left:50%;top:18%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:170px!important;margin:0!important;line-height:0}
.el-flecha svg{width:100%;height:auto}
.el-tag-a{left:calc(50% - 250px);bottom:26px}.el-tag-d{right:calc(50% - 260px);bottom:26px}
.el-ilu{position:absolute!important;right:16px;bottom:10px;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;opacity:.65;z-index:3}
.el-topo .el-ilu{color:#fff}

/* depoimentos (carrossel) */
.el-carr{position:relative;width:100%!important;max-width:1000px}
.el-trilho{overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-padding:0 4px;padding:4px 4px 18px!important;scrollbar-width:none;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.el-trilho::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.el-slide{flex:0 0 calc((100% - 32px)/3)!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;scroll-snap-align:start;overflow:hidden}
.el-slide-img{position:relative;width:100%!important}
.el-slide-img img{width:100%!important;aspect-ratio:906/1000;object-fit:cover;cursor:zoom-in}
.el-slide-img::after{content:"\2922";position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:8px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff;font-size:15px;line-height:28px;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.el-legenda{flex:1 1 auto!important}
.el-carr-nav{width:100%!important}
.cn-seta{position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 50px);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#fff;color:#111111;font-size:28px;line-height:40px;padding:0;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18);cursor:pointer;z-index:2;font-family:Poppins,sans-serif}
.cn-seta:disabled{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.cn-e{left:-16px}.cn-d{right:-16px}
.cn-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.cn-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;border:0;padding:0;background:#d8cfc5;cursor:pointer}
.cn-dot.cn-on{background:#F85A00;width:22px;border-radius:6px}
.carr-dica{margin-top:0!important;text-align:center;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#7a6f66}

/* dor: mulher com os pensamentos em balões */
.el-palco{position:relative;width:100%!important;max-width:900px;height:640px;margin-top:30px!important}
.el-palco-img{position:absolute!important;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);height:75%;width:auto!important;margin:0!important}
.el-palco-img img{height:100%!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 30px rgba(120,60,20,.25))}
.el-caixa{position:absolute!important;z-index:1;width:236px!important;margin:0!important;background:#fff;padding:20px 24px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(120,60,20,.16)}
.el-caixa::before,.el-caixa::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}
.el-caixa::before{width:20px;height:20px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(120,60,20,.14)}
.el-caixa::after{width:11px;height:11px}
.el-c1{top:0;left:120px}.el-c1::before{right:-4px;bottom:-14px}.el-c1::after{right:-26px;bottom:-36px;box-shadow:16px 16px 0 -2px #fff}
.el-c2{top:0;right:120px}.el-c2::before{left:-4px;bottom:-14px}.el-c2::after{left:-26px;bottom:-36px;box-shadow:-16px 16px 0 -2px #fff}
.el-c3{top:200px;left:70px}.el-c3::before{right:-30px;top:20px}.el-c3::after{right:-56px;top:14px;box-shadow:20px -8px 0 -2px #fff}
.el-c4{top:200px;right:70px}.el-c4::before{left:-30px;top:20px}.el-c4::after{left:-56px;top:14px;box-shadow:-20px -8px 0 -2px #fff}

/* elementos que não esticam dentro das linhas */
.el-alerta>.elementor-widget-image,.el-benef-img,.el-capa,.el-linha>.elementor-widget-icon,.el-valor,.el-pq .elementor-widget-icon,
.el-selos .elementor-widget-image,.el-opcao .elementor-widget-image{flex:0 0 auto!important;width:auto!important}
.el-benef-img img{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff7f0}
.elementor-widget-icon .elementor-icon{display:flex;line-height:0}

/* capas dos entregáveis, levemente giradas */
.el-capa img{border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.28);transform:rotate(-4deg)}
.el-capa-dir img{transform:rotate(4deg)}

/* para quem é */
.el-foto-pq img{width:100%}

/* oferta */
.el-oferta{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,#3a3a3a 0%,#111111 100%)!important;color:#fff}
.el-kit img{width:100%;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(80,30,0,.3)}
.el-preco,.el-preco p{display:flex!important;align-items:baseline;justify-content:center;line-height:1!important;margin:0!important}
.el-preco p{margin:0!important}
.el-preco span{line-height:1}
.el-preco .p1{font-size:44px}.el-preco .p2{font-size:118px;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0 2px}.el-preco .p3{font-size:50px}
.el-btn{width:100%!important;max-width:390px}
.el-btn .elementor-button{width:100%;min-height:55px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .3s}
.el-btn .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.el-selos{opacity:.92}
.el-selos>.e-con{width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.el-selos .elementor-widget-text-editor{width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.el-selos .elementor-widget-image img{height:24px;width:auto;filter:brightness(0) invert(1)}
.el-fita{position:absolute!important;top:26px;left:-48px;width:190px!important;margin:0!important;transform:rotate(-45deg);background:#F85A00;color:#fff;text-align:center;font-family:Poppins,sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:800;padding:5px 0;letter-spacing:.5px;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2);z-index:2}

/* duas opções: borda de cima colorida */
.el-opcao-x{border-top-color:#8e1f1b!important}.el-opcao-ok{border-top-color:#2e9d55!important}
.el-opcao .elementor-widget-image img{width:54px;height:54px}

/* Autora */
.el-aut-foto{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 78%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 78%,transparent 100%);border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.el-aut-foto img{width:100%}

/* perguntas frequentes */
.el-faq{margin-top:34px!important}
.el-faq .elementor-toggle-item{background:#fff7f0;border:1px solid #f3e2d3;border-radius:15px;padding:0 22px;margin-bottom:12px!important}
.el-faq .elementor-toggle-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0!important}
.el-faq .elementor-tab-title{border:0!important;padding:0!important;min-height:66px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer}
.el-faq .elementor-toggle-icon{width:14px!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;flex:none;font-size:14px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-start}
.el-faq .elementor-tab-content{border:0!important;padding:0 0 22px 24px!important}
.el-faq .elementor-toggle-title{flex:1}

/* ───────── celular ───────── */
@media (max-width:767px){
  .el-olho{padding:6px 14px;margin-bottom:14px!important}
  .el-chip{width:100%!important}
  .el-tag-la{left:10px;bottom:10px}.el-tag-ld{right:10px;bottom:10px}
  .el-par{height:380px}
  .el-flecha{width:100px!important;top:10%}
  .tag{font-size:11px;padding:5px 12px}
  .el-tag-a,.el-tag-d{bottom:16px}.el-tag-a{left:16%}.el-tag-d{right:16%}
  .el-ilu{bottom:auto;top:10px;right:12px}
  .el-carr{width:calc(100% + 40px)!important;max-width:none;margin-left:-20px!important;margin-right:-20px!important}
  .el-trilho{padding:4px 20px 18px!important;scroll-padding:0 20px}
  .el-slide{flex-basis:78%!important}
  .cn-seta{display:none}
  .el-palco{height:630px;margin-top:16px!important}
  .el-palco-img{height:340px}
  .el-caixa{width:54%!important;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:46%}
  .el-c1{top:0;left:0}.el-c2{top:64px;right:0;left:auto}.el-c3{top:128px;left:0}.el-c4{top:192px;right:0;left:auto}
  .el-c1::before,.el-c1::after,.el-c2::before,.el-c2::after,.el-c3::before,.el-c3::after{display:none}
  .el-c4::before{width:13px;height:13px;left:16%;top:auto;bottom:-15px}
  .el-c4::after{width:8px;height:8px;left:7%;top:auto;bottom:-30px;box-shadow:-11px 13px 0 -1px #fff}
  .el-pq{justify-content:flex-start!important}
  .el-preco .p1{font-size:40px}.el-preco .p2{font-size:104px}.el-preco .p3{font-size:46px}
  .el-aut-txt{order:-1}
  .el-aut-foto{width:100%;max-width:340px;margin:0 auto}
  .el-faq .elementor-tab-title{min-height:60px}
}
/* textos que dividem a linha com um ícone ou foto podem encolher (como no site) */
.e-con>.elementor-widget-text-editor,.e-con>.elementor-widget-heading{min-width:0}
.el-w100{width:100%!important;align-self:stretch}
.el-w100 img{width:100%!important}
/* Só a versão C (06/11, ajustes de visual pedidos na mentoria, modelo meuprimeirolow.com.br): faixa do topo de ponta a
   ponta, balões da ruminação empilhados sobre a foto, cartões de entregáveis, "para quem é" em lista e blocos mais
   compactos. Os tamanhos de texto ficam nos próprios elementos (editáveis no Elementor). */

/* topo: faixa laranja atrás da pílula, de ponta a ponta */
.vc-faixa{width:100%!important;align-self:stretch;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(120,50,10,.18)}
.vc-faixa-txt{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto!important;letter-spacing:-.2px}

/* ruminação: foto da cabeça ao quadril, balões em coluna à esquerda (como no modelo) */
.vc-palco{height:520px;max-width:660px;overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 88%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 88%,transparent 100%)}
.vc-palco .el-palco-img{top:0!important;bottom:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:40px!important;transform:none!important;height:760px!important}
.vc-palco .el-caixa{width:320px!important;left:0!important;right:auto!important;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:40%}
.vc-palco .el-c1{top:24px}.vc-palco .el-c2{top:120px}.vc-palco .el-c3{top:216px}.vc-palco .el-c4{top:312px}
.vc-palco .el-caixa::before,.vc-palco .el-caixa::after{display:block!important;left:auto!important;top:auto!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.vc-palco .el-caixa::before{width:14px;height:14px;right:-14px!important;bottom:8px}
.vc-palco .el-caixa::after{width:8px;height:8px;right:-28px!important;bottom:0}

/* entregáveis e bônus: 1 cartão por linha, metade capa e metade texto (modelo meuprimeirolow); no celular a capa vem em cima */
.vc-cab{position:relative}
.vc-mock{background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important}
.vc-selo-w{position:absolute!important;right:18px;bottom:18px;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;z-index:2}
.vc-selo{position:relative;width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.vc-selo svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.vc-selo text{font:800 9.6px Poppins,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.6px;fill:#F85A00}
.vc-selo img{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:64px!important;height:64px!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%}

/* para quem é: lista dentro de um cartão, foto pequena ao lado do título */
.vc-pq-foto{flex:0 0 auto!important;width:auto!important}
.vc-pq-foto img{width:88px;height:88px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:16px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.vc-pq-item>.elementor-widget-icon{flex:0 0 auto!important;width:auto!important;margin-top:3px}
.vc-ident>.elementor-widget-image{flex:0 0 auto!important;width:auto!important}

/* Autora: foto menor */
.vc-aut .el-aut-foto{max-width:380px}

/* perguntas mais compactas */
.vc-faq .elementor-toggle-item{margin-bottom:8px!important;padding:0 18px}
.vc-faq .elementor-tab-title{min-height:56px}

@media (max-width:767px){
  .vc-palco{height:410px;margin-top:14px!important}
  .vc-palco .el-palco-img{right:-4px!important;height:600px!important}
  .vc-palco .el-caixa{width:57%!important;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:42%}
  .vc-palco .el-c1{top:14px}.vc-palco .el-c2{top:84px}.vc-palco .el-c3{top:154px}.vc-palco .el-c4{top:224px}
  .vc-palco .el-caixa::before{width:10px;height:10px;right:-9px!important;bottom:6px}
  .vc-palco .el-caixa::after{width:6px;height:6px;right:-18px!important;bottom:0}
  .vc-selo-w{right:12px;bottom:12px}
  .vc-mock{aspect-ratio:3/2}
  .vc-selo{width:90px;height:90px}
  .vc-selo text{font-size:9.4px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
  .vc-selo img{width:50px!important;height:50px!important}
  .vc-pq-foto img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:14px}
  .vc-aut .el-aut-foto{max-width:250px}
  .vc-faq .elementor-tab-title{min-height:50px}
}
html,body{overflow-x:clip}
.pendente{background:#fff3b0;color:#5a4300;border:1px dashed #c9a400;border-radius:5px;padding:0 5px;font-weight:600;font-style:normal}
</style>
